steps: 1. Equip **Kerillian: Deepwood Staff** on a career other than Sister of the Thorn and build low, medium and high overcharge.
2. Swap away and back, let the overcharge decay, then cross a mission or respawn boundary and build charge again.
3. Record the bar colour and icon tint at each charge level, plus the warning flash, sounds, slowdown, lockout, drainability and recharge behaviour.
4. Repeat the whole sequence on Sister of the Thorn as the native control, then repeat the recharge leg with **Kerillian: Moonfire Bow**.
5. Run `/wt_regression_test` and attach the newest log.
assertions: on the non-Sister career the overcharge bar and icon use the same palette Sister of the Thorn shows natively in step 4 - the green presentation named in the report - at low, medium and high charge, and it survives swap-away-and-back plus the mission or respawn boundary. Gameplay is unchanged: warning flash, sounds, slowdown, lockout, drainability and stowed and wielded recharge all behave as on the native control. `/wt_regression_test` reports `PASS: issue388_deepwood_overcharge_profile`, and the log carries `[wt:388] Deepwood overcharge HUD hook installed`, one `[wt:388] Deepwood overcharge profile applied career=<career> transport=owner-authoritative` per career, and `[wt:388] Deepwood overcharge profile restored` on unequip. A default or career-standard bar instead of the Sister palette is a REGRESSION - attach the log and say which career and charge level.
Non-Sister with Deepwood: assert overcharge extension fields equal the we_thornsister profile and HUD bar colours equal Sister palette at 3 charge levels; restored on unequip. Sounds V.
